db_dir.description: Directory where SQLite databases (wordlist.db, etc.) are stored.

cache_size.description: SQLite cache size in MiB (1 MiB = 1,048,576 bytes). Recommended: one third of database file size.

min_dev.description: Minimum deviation from 0.5 required for a token to be used in classification.

robx.description: Spam probability assigned to tokens not yet seen (Robinson's x parameter).

robs.description: Weight (Robinson's s parameter) moving probabilities of rare tokens toward robx.

spam_cutoff.description: Threshold above (or equal) which messages are classified as spam.

ham_cutoff.description: Threshold below (or equal) which messages are classified as ham. If < spam-cutoff, tristate mode is active.

sp_esf.description: Effective size factor (ESF) for spam probability calculations. 1.0 = disabled (default).

ns_esf.description: Effective size factor (ESF) for nonspam probability calculations. 1.0 = disabled (default).

spam_header_name.description: Name of the header field to use for classification output (e.g., X-Bogosity).
